title: Optional prose-wait heuristic
goal: A prompt to check when a wait written in prose names an item that is done or cancelled
acceptance: A sentence in an open record's Next action or Check, or in the solution order note, naming repo:ID with a waiting word (waits, after, blocked by) where that item is done or cancelled gives a gap: the owning repository rewrites the wait
Worded as a prompt to check, never proof, like the cross-repository kind
Fixture tests in tools/test-profiles.mjs, committed failing first: the heuristic stays quiet on a wait that names an open item
privacy: Fixtures are invented repositories and manifests; no personal data.
escalation: A change to how existing gap kinds behave goes back to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed: one text heuristic modelled on the cross-repository kind, plus fixtures. Not a measurement.
